To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) digital psychiatry is a comprehensive approach that can be used in mitigation of stress disorders in societies overwhelmed by human disasters; 2) it includes an array of new tools and means based on artificial intelligence, telemedicine, computer assisted mental health tools, etc. and 3) it is an important part of a comprehensive package of measures to address mental health issues related to human disasters, including the ongoing global COVID 19 Pandemics.
the global COVID 10 pandemic and other human disasters have a devastating impact on mental health, which can be addressed by the comprehensive approach based on digital technologies.
digital psychiatry can play a significant role in mitigation of adverse impact of global pandemics on mental health.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of novel digital tools and means for assessment and mitigation of stress related mental health disorders, which will be particularly important in the forthcoming post pandemic period, when a large number of people will be in need of psychiatric services, which will be stretched to the limits by the ongoing pandemic.
the development and evaluation of digital psychiatry tools, which are designed to mitigate stress related disorders and enhance mental health in afflicted societies.
the development and application of digital psychiatry tools for the assessment and mitigation of mental health effects of large scale human disasters.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the COVID 19 pandemic has a devastating effect on mental health of individuals and societies, which is further aggravated by the lack of access of psychiatric services in many countries.
, the COVID 19 pandemic is a global human disaster with a potential for massive adverse impact on mental health, but also with a potential for a positive change and a new era of digital psychiatry.
the ongoing COVID 19 pandemic is the most severe human disaster in the recent history, with devastating impact on the mental health of individuals, groups and societies.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are in a unique position to develop and utilize digital technologies in order to mitigate the negative impact of the global COVID 10 pandemic on mental health.
digital psychiatry can be a key element in the whole package of interventions to address mental health challenges of the COVID 19 pandemic and similar human catastrophes.

digital technologies and tools can be used as a part of a comprehensive package of measures to address mental health challenges related to the ongoing COVID 19 pandemic, as well as other human disasters, in a number of different ways, including prevention, early identification, assessment and monitoring, and treatment.
The main takeaway from our work is that
digital psychiatry has the potential to become an important part of mental health care in the current situation of global pandemic and other human disasters, and in future as well.

digital psychiatry can be utilized as an effective and efficient tool in prevention and treatment of mental disorders in societies overwhelmed by human disasters, including global pandemics, like COVID 19.
the ongoing COVID 19 pandemic, as well as other large scale human disasters should be addressed by comprehensive approach based on digital psychiatric tools and means.
